about_the_game:
The Last Sip – Version 1.0 (Unreal Engine)

The Last Sip offers a short yet atmospheric single-player experience that blends exploration, light puzzles, and sci-fi horror elements. You wake up in a mysterious facility with no memory of how you got there. As you explore, you begin to uncover unsettling clues about a strange transformation and your forgotten past.

What’s Included in Version 1.0:

  • Core Gameplay Mechanics: Simple yet effective controls focused on exploration and discovery.

  • Environmental Storytelling: Discover hidden messages and details that gradually reveal the story.

  • Atmospheric Sci-Fi Environment: Explore a handcrafted level with immersive sound and visual design.

  • Short and Focused Experience: Ideal for players looking for a brief but memorable game.

This version is designed to provide a compact yet impactful experience, especially for fans of mystery, atmosphere, and minimal storytelling.

Future Plans:

The game is still in development. Based on community feedback, we plan to add:

  • New areas to explore

  • Visual and audio enhancements

  • Expanded story content and lore

  • Additional puzzles and secrets

💬 If you enjoy the concept of The Last Sip, please let us know in the reviews or comments. Community interest will directly influence how the game evolves and what new content gets added in future updates.

content_descriptors.notes: The Last Sip contains psychological themes and a dark, unsettling atmosphere. The game does not include explicit sexual content, drug use, or graphic violence. However, some scenes may be disturbing to sensitive players due to the themes of transformation and isolation.
